GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own, so it is the last trophy by design. The two golds usually land last: A Long Road (100% completion) and the final mission. Guides put the whole list at around 200 hours, so treat this as a long project, not a weekend. Play the story first, then clean up the map, and the platinum follows the 100% trophy immediately.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Time estimate (~200 hours): PowerPyx via GTA Zone and KeenGamer.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn: just play the opening and it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission name: GTA Zone and KeenGamer trophy lists.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy that unlocks on its own when the chapter's final mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is the one step in the game that can disappear.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Chapter 1 meditation warning: GTA Zone (PowerPyx and GTABase) and KeenGamer.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy that unlocks as you play. From this chapter on, Jason and Lucia are both playable, which opens up the trophies that need the two of them together.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Both playable from Chapter 2: Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy that unlocks on its own when the chapter ends. The robbery trophies start opening up around this part of the story, so bank vaults and armored trucks become worth trying from here.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Robbery trophies opening in Chapters 3 and 4: Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy that unlocks on its own when the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: the game has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back to a chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No mission replay, keep manual saves: Output Lag and KeenGamer.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission, the story's finale and one of the two gold trophies. It usually lands just before the platinum. Keep a manual save before the final mission: with no mission replay, that save is the only way to replay the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No mission replay, manual saves: Output Lag and KeenGamer.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy that unlocks as you play the campaign; no side work is needed for it.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission list: GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy that unlocks as you play the campaign; just follow the story and it pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission list: GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A story trophy that unlocks as you play the campaign.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission list: GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story trophy that unlocks as you play the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission list: GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy that unlocks as you play the campaign.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission list: GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy that unlocks as you play the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Mission list: GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The game's 35-task checklist covers the story, activities, collectibles and challenges, and it is tracked in the Progress menu once the story is done; progress made earlier still counts, and nothing on the checklist can be missed. This is the hardest trophy on the list and usually the last one before the platinum, so treat it as the clean-up phase after the credits: work the checklist top to bottom instead of wandering.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 35-task checklist, Progress menu, nothing on it missable: GTA Vice City Hub and GTA Zone. Hardest trophy: PowerPyx via GTA Zone.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida count. The map holds 397 stunts in total, and 300 of them count toward 100% completion, so you will pass 250 on the way to full completion without grinding it separately. Chain stunt jumps on highways and ramps in free roam and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 397 stunts in total, 300 for 100%: GTA Zone.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types on the map: play one round of each, from races and the shooting range to fishing, the arcade, bowling, drone races and meditation, and it pops. Use the map's activity icons to find one of each type.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 9 activity types: GTA Zone and Of Zen and Computing trophy lists.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold is required, not just a pass, so treat each range as its own small skill test: learn the target pattern first, then go for score. Challenges can be retried freely, so replay the ones you miss instead of grinding them all at once.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 42 challenges: the official list's counts, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations, and one win at each counts. Fly a slow practice run first to learn the gates, then race clean lines and cut corners only where the gates allow it.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 14 locations: the official list's counts, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count, across street, off-road, boat and air races; winning the same event twice does not count twice. Work through the race icons on the map and the count fills up as you go.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not let the line snap when the fish runs.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to its end; the earliest machines are in Vice City's arcades, so this is an easy early trophy once the map opens up.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's stranger mission strand to its last mission; the strand opens as a stranger marker on the map and its missions unlock one after another.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Side character strand: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Side character strand: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Side character strand: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Eight full stranger strands count. The side characters Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone plus Bret's hunt and the other strangers fill the eight, so finish the side strands as they appear on the map instead of leaving them for the end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Side character strands: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Side character strand: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Side character strand: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 first: it is the one step in the whole game that can disappear, because the chapter ends and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, then work through the rest while you explore.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 18 spots in 10 locations and the Chapter 1 warning: GTA Zone (PowerPyx and GTABase) and KeenGamer. Only potentially missable: Output Lag, GTA Zone and KeenGamer.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's stranger strand until the hunt opens, then track the unique animal and take it down. Move slowly, stay downwind, and use the hunting prompts the game gives you.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Bret's hunt: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the collectible cards scattered across Leonida and finish any 3 full sets. The map's collectible tracker shows which sets are still incomplete, so sweep one region at a time instead of hunting cards at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find the WAiNK spots, the WAiNK markers on walls and street art around the state, and tag 100 of them. Cities are dense with spots, so clear Vice City first and then work outward along the highways.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, and 70 of them count toward 100% completion, so 50 is the easier bar: work through the combat, driving and exploration challenges as you play and the count climbs on its own. Save the fiddly ones for the clean-up phase.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 80 challenges in total, 70 for 100%: GTA Zone.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, Jason and Lucia together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Alleys, tunnels and water break the search faster than outrunning it on a highway.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Partner play from Chapter 2: Output Lag.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob a shop, keep the wanted level, and immediately rob two more shops in a row. Plan a route through three close shops first and drive between them; do not stop to fight the police.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Encountering 100 distinct vehicle models counts, on the road, in traffic and parked, so the list fills as you simply drive around the state. Rare models hide in rich districts and at special spots, so vary your routes instead of driving the same highway.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with 5 enemies close together, a gang hideout or a wanted-level fight works, and drop all 5 before the focus ends. Pick a tight spot so the enemies stay grouped.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. Take a plane and leave without following the scheduled departure: steal an aircraft from the runway or tarmac and get airborne before security closes in.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem with it. Tanks show up at high wanted levels and at military spots, so push your wanted level up in open ground and watch for the Rhino rolling in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Enter the store, take the goods and leave without any guard or camera spotting you. Go at night, move slowly, and stay out of the staff's line of sight; if anyone spots you, the attempt fails, so leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies open in Chapters 3 and 4, so this is a later-game trophy: work through the five vaults one at a time and get away clean after each one, since the escape is part of the requirement.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Vault robberies opening in Chapters 3 and 4: Output Lag.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and escape before the police close in. A quiet stretch of road beats a busy intersection for the getaway.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state; the map fills in as you travel, so drive the highways and back roads and the last few areas will be the remote corners. A boat helps with the islands and coastline.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 52 areas: the official list's counts, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs: rob one illegal operation for each of them. Mark the gang territories on the map and work through them one at a time, since each gang's operation sits in its own turf.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 9 gangs: the official list's counts, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view: a quiet moment trophy, not a mission, and one of the few trophies with no confirmed method published at launch, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try another spot on the beachfront.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No confirmed method at launch: Output Lag.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front and out the other side, the classic GTA showroom smash. It is one of the few trophies with no confirmed method published at launch, so a fast car and a straight line through the glass are the way to try it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No confirmed method at launch: Output Lag.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City and finish it to the end.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This reads as a story moment with your partner that pops as the campaign plays: keep playing the story and it unlocks on its own. It is a hidden trophy, so it stays out of your list until it pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Story trophies unlock as you play: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make story choices as the campaign offers them; the count PlayStation tracks for this one runs to 500, so it is a long-horizon trophy that fills as you play through choices across the whole story rather than something to grind in one sitting.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Count runs to 500: the official list's counts, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed on a second try. Fail an attempt at something, then land it on the retry. No confirmed method has been published at launch, so treat this as a retry-based moment trophy rather than a grind: it should pop naturally when a retry goes right.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No confirmed method at launch: Output Lag.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida: the description points at one of the game's odd world events. No confirmed method has been published at launch, so keep exploring the map's strange corners, the desert, the swamps and the coast at night, and it should trigger on its own.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No confirmed method at launch: Output Lag.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, a drive-by with a melee weapon instead of a gun. No confirmed method has been published at launch, so try it in free-roam traffic with a slow vehicle and a clear run.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No confirmed method at launch: Output Lag.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean; the laundering route opens as the story's money systems come online, so bank the bills as you earn them and clean them in batches during the clean-up phase.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and food all count, and the total accumulates over the whole playthrough, so it usually pops on its own late in the game. If you are short near the end, buy the big-ticket cars and weapons you still want.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Each one needs cash, so this is a late-game purchase after the story's big paydays; buy them as you can afford them and the last one pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 8 garages: the official list's counts, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles you own or find to the Scooter Bros app; each registration counts once per vehicle, so ten different vehicles do the job.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Official description, PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.
